rules.sectionReferenceMeaning: Use the accepted Latin Niese registry. XVI–XVII use its explicit anchored physical spans, with XVI split sections grouped only for Boolean scope. XVIII–XIX combine actual Niese milestones with explicitly adopted paragraph/element starts. XX honors its partial XX.26 end target. Unavailable identities create no synthetic records.
rules.textTransformations: Exclude marked labels, notes, headings, trailers and front matter. Three literal XVI [...] notices outside accepted intervals and the inherited XX annotation between its accepted XX.26 end and XX.37 start are excluded reversibly. Retain all other source characters, including untagged Roman chapter letters and add/del/unclear/corr/expan content. Trim physical paragraph-fragment edges and join continuing paragraphs with two newlines.
rules.phraseBoundaries: Exact phrases follow the physical source sequence and cannot jump between displaced fragments. Actual TEI gaps and literal dotted interruptions block adjacency. The explicit excluded notices between XVI.188 and 200 and XX.26 and 37 also block adjacency; skipped registry identities alone do not.
rules.editorialMarkup: Preserve exact add/del/unclear attributes and UTF-16 spans in editorialMarks; corr/expan/s/ref appear in sourceMarkup. Do not silently correct readings, omit marginal source words, or generate display glyphs.
rules.unknownContent: Require the frozen accepted XML and identity-registry hashes, with CRLF/LF equivalence. A changed source, unresolved boundary, overlapping interval, lost running character or unreviewed empty span stops extraction.
rules.sourceProjectionDefinition: Each original narrative paragraph is exactly restored from finished recordId slices plus excluded labels/notes and reversible edge whitespace. Anonymous paragraphs use an explicit xpath: source locator, never an invented XML id.
rules.offsetDefinition: Audit sourceText, flat and recordText coordinates are Python Unicode characters, end exclusive. Published inline marks, textGaps and phraseBreaks use JavaScript UTF-16 offsets.
rules.tokenCountDefinition: Unicode L/N start and L/M/N continuation, with explicit source gaps interrupting token formation. The accepted XVII.41–42 milestone separates eleuati and cum without an intervening source space; this precisely audited section boundary separates search tokens and preserves whole-book phrase adjacency.
rules.readerRoute: /antiquities/?book=20&niese={section}; split XVI sections display their accepted physical portions in witness order.

excluded.text: I Quem ad modum claudius pius agrippe mortem factum presidem miserit in iudaeam et dictio filadelfinorum et quia factus indignatus iudaeis qui transfluuium erant positi primos tres uiros eorum comprehendens occidentali
II Quomodo ptolomeus principes latronum, arab latrocinia inferens captus est et deductus ad fatum noscitur interemptus

III Quias .tus et cassius longinus, syriae praesens ascendens in ierosolimam praeceperunt primatibus iudaeorum ut talarem et pontificalem uestem in antonia constituerent sub potestate romanorum sicut et prius erat et quia rogantes fatum iudęis et longinum eis concedentibus legationem ad caesarem claudium destinarent.
IIII Quomodo claudius caesar rogatus ab agrippa iuuenem cessit iudęis petitiones suas et fato rescripsit.
V Quem ammodum elena adiabenorum regni et ei filii monobazus et iazatus et omne genus eorum sollomnitates zelatis iudaeorum
VI De fame quue in prouincia contigit VII Quomodo tyberius alexander in iudaem directus, aministrator filios iudę galilea et populum seducentes occidit.
VIII Qui herode moriente calcidis rege agrippa iuuenis hunc habuit principatum caesare sibi claudio conferente.
VIIII Quia aduentum cum magnis praesidis in iudaeam caesare destinati sub eo multi sacerdotum perierunt in templo.
X Seditio iudaeorum contra samaritas et quia multi samaritanorum extincti sunt

XI Quia modius quadratus, syriae praeses audiens hęc et ascendens in iudeam primates iudaeorum atque samaritanorum romam iussit ascendere parit et cum manum et celerem ut claudio caesari deberent ex his quae fuerant gesta reddere rationem et quia quosdam iudaeorum ipse puniuit.
XII Qui ad audius audiens inter eos iudaeos quidem absoluit a culpa rogatur, ab agrippa rege cum annum uero exilio deportauit celerem autem millenarium et samaritanorum primatis asperrime aflicauit.
XIII Quia felix missus iudex et inueniens prouinciam latronibus nimis afflictam prospexit ut illis interemptis pacem tribuerit religioni principem uero latronum elezarum uinctum direxit ad caesarem.
XIII Quem ad modum claudio moriente nero succesit.
XI Quia ueniente aegytio malefico et multis iudaeorum ab eo reductis felix adgressus eorum multos occidit.
XVI Quem ammodum primos iudaeorum et syros in caesaream concertantes felix ab intentione segregauit
XVII Quomodo portio festo in iudaeam misso contigit prouinciam sicharus commoueri.

XVIII De porticu interiorem templi et quem ammodum eam exaltauere iudaei et quia festus ob hoc indiga at primates iudęorum rome destinauit ad neronem ut ei quae gesserant satifacerent et quia moriente in iudaea festo successor uenit albinus.
XVIII Quia sub eo ancte prouincialium siccarii cessauerunt.
XX Quia florus ueniens albino successor tantis malis iudęos affecit ac eos adma uenire compelleret.
Bamberg Msc. Class. 78
